n-k-k9-01.title: Ma cinwaanku wuxuu sheegayaa wax ka badan sahanka?
n-k-k9-01.goal: Is barbar dhig cinwaan war iyo tirooyinka sahanka ee maqaalka, go'aami erayada cinwaanka ee dhaafaya cadaynta, oo qor cinwaan aan dhaafin.
n-k-k9-01.material:
Goob war oo deegaan ayaa daabacday maqaalkan.

[제목] 주민 대다수, 공원 야간 개방에 찬성

[본문] 구청이 지난 3일 공원 이용객 50명에게 설문한 결과, 야간 개방에 찬성한 사람은 28명이었다. 반대는 15명, 모르겠다는 응답은 7명이었다. 설문은 낮 시간에 공원 입구에서만 진행됐다. 구청은 "주민 전체의 의견으로 보기는 어렵다"며 추가 조사를 하겠다고 밝혔다.
n-k-k9-01.thinking.0: Hubinta sheegasho iyadoo la eegayo cadaynta ka dambeysa
n-k-k9-01.thinking.1: Ogaanshaha erayada tirada (대다수, 과반) iyo erayada kooxda (주민, 이용객)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhrin karaa maqaal war gaaban oo qaab qoran ah (-했다, -밝혔다)
n-k-k9-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan erayada 찬성/반대, 설문, 응답, 절반
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.prompt: Is barbar dhig cinwaanka iyo tirooyinka qoraalka. Erayadee cinwaanka ayaa dhaafaya waxa sahanku muujiyo? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.0: Qor yaa la weydiiyey, xagee iyo goorma, adigoo isticmaalaya qoraalka jidhka oo keliya.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.hint.1: U beddel 28 ka mid ah 50 saamiga, kadibna weydii haddii saamigaasi ku habboon yahay erayga tirada cinwaanka.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.c: Taageeruhu waa sax waxa 28-ka qof yidhaahdeen, sidaas darteed erayga waxaa taageera tirooyinka.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.r.d: Furitaanka habeenkii waa mawduuca su'aasha sahanka, sidaas darteed erayga sidoo kale waa la taageeray.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.explain: Kaliya booqdayaasha beerta ee maalinta dhex maray albaabka ayaa la weydiiyey, sidaas darteed '주민' wuu ka balaaran yahay cadaynta. 28 ka mid ah 50 waa 56 boqolkiiba, wax yar ka badan badh, taasoo aan ahayn '대다수'. '찬성' iyo '야간 개방' waxay waafaqsan yihiin sahanka.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.0: Kooxdu waa wax-dhaaf runta ah (maqaalka laftiisa ayaa sheegaya). Sidoo kale hubi sida xooggan 대다수 ugu leeyahay 28 ka mid ah 50.
n-k-k9-01.s.s1.acc.1: Erayga xooggan waa wax-dhaaf runta ah. Sidoo kale hubi cidda runtii la weydiiyey: booqdayaal hal meel iyo hal waqti oo keliya.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.prompt: Cinwaanee ayaa si fiican ugu habboon cadaynta?
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cinwaan kasta hubi laba shay: kooxda iyo tirada.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dib u xisaabi saamiga doorashada isticmaalaysa boqolkiiba kale.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.a: Tani weli waxay leedahay 주민, koox sahanku aan daboolin, inkasta oo 과반 la jaanqaadayo saamiga.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.c: 70 boqolkiiba wuxuu isku qasaa 28-ka qof ee taageeray iyo 7-ta ee ku jawaabay 'ma hubo'; 56 boqolkiiba oo keliya ayaa yidhi way taageeraan.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.r.d: 28 taageer iyo 15 mucaarad ma aha kala badh, 주민-na mar kale aad bay u balaaran tahay.
n-k-k9-01.s.s2.explain: 28 ka mid ah 50 waa 56 boqolkiiba, kuwa la weydiiyeyna waxay ahaayeen booqdayaasha beerta. Cinwaanku wuxuu magacaabaa kooxda iyo tirada labadaba.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.prompt: Qor HAL cinwaan cusub (hal sadar Kuuriyaan ah) oo soo sheega sahankan adigoon dhaafin.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ku bilow kooxda la weydiiyey, kadibna tirada ama saamiga, kadibna falka 찬성.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka tag eray kasta oo ka balaaran ama ka xooggan waxa aad xisaabin kartid.
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma akhristuhu ogaan karaa cidda ka jawaabay sahanka?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tirada cinwaankayga waa mid aan ka xisaabin karo qoraalka jidhka?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma jiro eray natiijada ka dhigaya mid ka xooggan 56 boqolkiiba 50 booqdayaal?
n-k-k9-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Wuxuu isticmaalaa 절반 넘게 halkii boqolkiiba.

n-k-k9-03.title: Yaa ku biiri kara xerada barnaamijyada?
n-k-k9-03.topic: Xadadka qaanuunnada: 이상, 이하, 초과, 미만 (dhis dhawr xal)
n-k-k9-03.goal: Akhri ogeysiis leh erayada xadka, xalli qiimayaasha la oggol yahay, dhis dhawr kooxood oo buuxiya qaanuun kasta hal mar, oo ka warbixi hal Kuuriyaan ahaan.
n-k-k9-03.thinking.0: Akhrinta erayada xadka (이상, 이하, 초과, 미만) si sax ah
n-k-k9-03.thinking.1: Helitaanka natiijo qarsoon (khidmaddu waxay xadidaysaa cabbirka kooxda)
n-k-k9-03.thinking.2: Soo saarista dhawr xal oo sax ah iyo hubinta mid kasta
n-k-k9-03.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 만 ~세 (da' caalami ah) iyo 명
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.prompt: Hadallee ayaa ogeysiisku oggol yahay? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.0: Sawir xariiq lambar ah oo calaamadee lambar xad kasta sida ku jira ama aan ku jirin.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii haddii erayga macnaheedu yahay 'oo ay ku jirto lambarkan' ama 'ka dambeeya lambarkan'.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.a: Qof 14 jir ah (만 14세) wuxuu ku jiri karaa koox.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.b: Qof 19 jir ah (만 19세) wuxuu ku jiri karaa koox.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.b: Hubi waxa 미만 lambarka laftiisa u sameeyo: 'ka hooseeya 19' ma ku darto 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.c: Khidmad kooxeed sax 20,000 won waa fiicnaan lahayd.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.r.c: Hubi waxa 초과 lambarka laftiisa u sameeyo: 'ka badan 20,000' ma ku darto 20,000.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.o.d: Khidmad kooxeed sax 30,000 won waa fiicnaan lahayd.
n-k-k9-03.s.s1.explain: 이상 iyo 이하 waxay ku daraan lambarka laftiisa; 초과 iyo 미만 ma darin. Sidaas darteed 14 waa gudaha, 19 waa dibadda, 20,000 waa dibadda, 30,000-na waa gudaha.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.prompt: Dhis 3 koox oo kala duwan oo buuxiya qaanuun kasta. n = tirada xubnaha, y = da'da xubinta ugu yar, o = da'da xubinta ugu weyn (sano dhan).
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi khidmadda 3, 4 iyo 5 xubnood ka hor intaadan dooran da'da.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore dooro da'da ugu yar, kadibna ta ugu weyn 3 sano gudahood oo ka hooseeya 19.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c0: Isticmaal tirooyin dhan dadka iyo da'daha.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Qof walba waa 14 ama ka weyn.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Xubinta ugu yar waa ka yar 만 14세.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Xubinta ugu weyn waa inay ka yartahay 만 19세, sidaas darteed 19 lama oggola.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Kan ugu weyn ugu yaraan wuxuu la jaanqaadaa kan ugu yar.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Xubinta ugu weyn ma ka yaraan karto kan ugu yar.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Farqiga da'du waa ka badan 3 sano.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.ok.c6: Khidmadda kooxdu waa ka badan 20,000 oo ugu badnaan 30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.fail.c6: Khidmadda kooxda (7,000 x xubnaha) waa inay ka badan tahay 20,000 oo ugu badnaan 30,000 won.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.explain: Qaanuunka khidmadda wuxuu oggolaadaa 3 xubnood oo keliya (21,000 won) ama 4 xubnood (28,000 won), inkasta oo qaanuunka kooxdu leeyahay ilaa 5. Da'duhu waa inay u dhexeeyaan 14 iyo 18 oo farqi ugu badnaan 3.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro HAL koox oo ka mid ah kuwaaga oo qor fariin diiwaangelin gaaban oo loo diro abaabulaha Kuuriyaan ahaan (hadal edeb leh): tirada xubnaha, da'da ugu yar iyo ugu weyn, iyo wadarta khidmadda.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Isticmaal hal saf oo ka mid ah kooxahaaga: saddex lambar.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Qor xubnaha, kadibna da'daha, kadibna khidmadda, weedh kasta oo si edeb leh u dhammaaday.
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma tirooyinka fariintayda waxay waafaqsan yihiin hal koox oo aan dhistay?
n-k-k9-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma wadarta khidmaddu waa 7,000 won oo lagu dhuftay tirada xubnaha?

n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad ilaa hadda akhrisay oo keliya.
n-k-k9-04.topic: Jees-jees iyo macnaha guud (muuji oo dib u eeg)
n-k-k9-04.goal: Akhri hal weedh marka macnaha guud dheeraad ahi yimaado, ogow sida macnuhu u isu rogo ammaan iyo jees-jees, oo si edeb leh uga jawaab hadal jees-jees ah.
n-k-k9-04.material: Isniin subax. Kooxdaada waxay leedahay kulan usbuuciyeed. Waxaad gashaa qolka 팀장님 (hoggaamiyaha kooxda)-na wuxuu kuu yidhi hal weedh. Akhri qayb kasta, dooro akhrinta u muuqata mid ugu badan, kadibna sii wad.
n-k-k9-04.thinking.0: Kala saarista macnaha dhabta ah iyo jees-jeesta
n-k-k9-04.thinking.1: Dib u eegidda akhrin marka xaqiiqooyin cusub yimaadaan
n-k-k9-04.thinking.2: Ka jawaabidda macnaha, ma aha erayada oo keliya
n-k-k9-04.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan hadalka edebta leh (-요, -습니다) iyo dhammaadka -네요
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta oo dooro macnaha ugu badan ee weedha 팀장님 ka hor intaadan sii wadin.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii xaqiiqooyinka waqtiga iyo hab-dhaqanka hadlaha ee ka dhigi lahaa erayada run ama been.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxay 팀장님 u badan tahay inay sameyneyso weedhdan?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Macno guud la'aan labada akhrin way suurtagal yihiin: '참 ...도' wuxuu muujin karaa u-yaabid dhab ah ama xad-dhaaf jees-jees ah. Erayada keligood ma go'aamiyaan.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kuu weydiisanaysa inaad hore timaaddo marka xigta
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Weedha waxba kuma jiraan weydiisanaya isbeddel mustaqbal; codsi wuxuu isticmaali lahaa dhammaad sida -아 주세요.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Dhammaadku waa hadal (-네요), ma aha su'aal waqtiga.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda macnaha weedha waa maxay inta badan?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Waxaa la yidhi lidka xaqiiqada (hore vs 40 daqiiqo daahday), dhoolla caddayn la'aan: tani waa jees-jees. Arday tarjumaya erayada oo keliya wuu seegi lahaa dhaleecaynta.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kulanku horey ayuu u dhamaaday 40 daqiiqo, sidaas darteed cidina si daacad ah ugu ammaani karin imaatinkan.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kaftan saaxiibtinimo oo ku saabsan cimilada
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Su'aal dhexdhexaad ah oo ku saabsan jadwalka
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hadlaha waxba ma weydiinayo; eegista saacadda waxay tilmaamaysaa faallo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Macluumaadkan cusub, maxay macnaheedu yahay weedha 팀장님?
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Xaqiiqooyinku hadda waxay waafaqsan yihiin erayada, sidaa darteed weedha waxaa loola jeedaa macnaheeda dhabta ah (laga yaabo si diirran). Macnaha guud wuxuu abuuri karaa kaftan lid ah (irony) wuxuuna meesha ka saari karaa.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Weli kaftan lid ah: dhaleecayn ku saabsan daahitaanka
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kulanka 10:30 markuu yahay 50 daqiiqo ayaad goor hore timid, sidaa darteed daahitaan lagu dhaleeceeyo ma jiro.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Hadal runta ah: runtii waad goor hore timid
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Tilmaan ah inaad qolka ka baxdo
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tilmaan taas ma jirto; kafeega iyo qososhu waxay tilmaamaan saaxiibtinimo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Su'aal ku saabsan goorta ogeysiiska la dhejiyay
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Weedhu su'aal ma aha ogeysiiska na kuma sheegna.
n-k-k9-04.s.s1.reflect: Erayadu weligood ma beddelmin; xaqiiqooyinkaa beddelmay. Marka weedh sheegto wax aan la jaan qaadin xaqiiqooyinka (halkan, 'goor hore' qof daahay), dhegeystuhu wuxuu u akhriyaa kaftan lid ah (반어). Xaqiiqooyin cusub ayaa sidoo kale meesha ka saari kara akhrintaas.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.prompt: Ku laabo qaybta labaad: kulanku wuxuu bilaabmay 9:00 adiguna waxaad timid 9:40. U jawaab 팀장님 hadal edeb leh, adigoo ka jawaabaya waxa hadalku runtii ula jeedo.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow magacaabidda waxa aad khaldantay hal weedh oo gaaban.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dhammee waxa aad sameyn doonto mar dambe.
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma jawaabtaydu waxay muujisaa inaan hadalka u fahmay dhaleecayn?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sababtayda ama ballantayda mid uu lataliye aqbali karaa?
n-k-k9-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sidan baan ula hadli lahaa 팀장님 (edeb leh, ma aha mid is-difaaca)?

n-k-k9-02.title: Isku xire rogaya dooda
n-k-k9-02.topic: Isku xirayaasha dood ku jira (hel oo saxo khalad)
n-k-k9-02.goal: Hel sadarka isku xirihiisu dooda u horjeedo jihada khaldan, dooro isku xiraha soo celinaya macquulnimada, oo dib u qor sadarka.
n-k-k9-02.material: Arday ayaa qoray baaragaraaf gaaban oo ku saabsan shaqada guriga ee majaladda dugsiga. Hal isku xire ma jaanqaado macquulnimada.
n-k-k9-02.thinking.0: Akhrinta isku xirayaasha sida tilmaamo jiho (ku darid, is-hor-taag, natiijo)
n-k-k9-02.thinking.2: Hagaajinta dooda iyadoo isbeddel ugu yar
n-k-k9-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu akhrin karaa weedho gaaban oo qaab qoran ah (-다)
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro sadarka eraygiisa furitaanka ee isku xiruhu uga soo horjeedo jihada dooda.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.0: Erayadaada ku dheh shaqada sadar kasta ka qabto baaragaraafka, kadibna eeg sida eraygiisa furitaanka ugu xirmo sadarka ka horreeya.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.hint.1: Isku xire kasta weydii haddii sadarku sii wato jihada sadarka hore ama uu uga leexdo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 wuxuu ka leexdaa faa'iido (sadarka 2) ilaa dhibaato, laakiin isku xirihiisu wuxuu ku daraa wax kale oo isku nooc ah. Eray is-hor-taag ayaa halkaas loo baahan yahay. Sadarrada 4 iyo 5 si sax ah ayay u bixiyaan natiijo iyo gabagabo.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.prompt: Isku xirihee ayaa bedeli kara erayga furitaanka sadarkaas?
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ingiriis ahaan dheh xidhiidhka sadarku la leeyahay midka ka horreeya.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isku day doorasho kasta weedha dhexdeeda oo arag haddii labada sadar weli macno wada leeyihiin.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.a: Tani waxay sheegi lahayd dhibaatadu waa natiijo faa'iidada, taasoo macno la'aan ah.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.b: Dhibaatadu ma aha tusaale faa'iidada sadarka 2.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.r.d: Tani waxay soo bandhigi lahayd dhibaatada sida sababta faa'iidada.
n-k-k9-02.s.s2.explain: Baaragaraafku wuxuu ka dhaqaaqayaa faa'iido ilaa cillad, sidaas darteed isku xirihu waa inuu calaamadeeyaa is-hor-taag.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka khaldan adigoo isticmaalaya isku xire ku habboon (ilaali inta kale ee weedha). Kadibna ku dar HAL weedh adiga ah oo ku bilaabata eray natiijo (tusaale 그래서 ama 따라서) oo ka soo raacda dhibaatada.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.0: Beddel eraygii ugu horreeyay ee sadarka khaldan oo keliya.
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.hint.1: Weedha cusub, weydii: dhibaatadan awgeed, maxay shirkaduhu sameeyaan ama u baahan yihiin?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma isku xirahaygu wuxuu muujiyaa ka leexasho faa'iido ilaa dhibaato?
n-k-k9-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma weedhayga dheeraadka ahi runtii wuxuu ka soo raacaa dhibaatada, ma aha faa'iidada?

n-k-k9-05.title: U sheegidda ayeeyada lacagta baska
n-k-k9-05.topic: Warka oo loo beddelay Kuuriyaan hadal ah oo loogu talagalay ayeeyo (dib u qorid dhegeyste)
n-k-k9-05.goal: Dib u qor weedh war ah oo Kuuriyaan hadal edeb leh ah ayeeyo 68 jir ah, adigoo ilaalinaya waxa hubaal ah, waxa la qorsheeyay oo keliya, iyo waxa iyada khuseeya.
n-k-k9-05.material:
Waxaad ku akhrisay maqaalkan telefoonkaaga. Ayeeyadaa (68) waxay kula nooshahay waxayna baska raacdaa maalin kasta. Ma akhriso wararka.

[기사] 시는 다음 달 1일부터 시내버스 기본요금을 1,500원에서 1,700원으로 200원 인상할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 다만 만 65세 이상 어르신의 요금은 현행 1,500원으로 유지된다.
n-k-k9-05.thinking.0: Beddelidda heerka hadalka iyo doorashada erayada dhegeyste cusub
n-k-k9-05.thinking.1: Ilaalinta xaqiiqooyinka iyo xaaladdooda (la qorsheeyay, ma la samayn) marka dib loo sheego
n-k-k9-05.thinking.2: Hormarinta waxa dhegeystahan muhiim u ah
n-k-k9-05.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan -ㄴ/는대요 (hadal la soo sheegay) iyo 예정
n-k-k9-05.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 존댓말 iyo qaabka qoraalka wararka
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.prompt: Ayeeyadaa codkaaga ayaad u sheegi doontaa. Dib-u-sheegidee ayaa warka dhega-nuglayn lahaa?
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.0: Hal mar akhri maqaalka oo ku taxay xaqiiqooyinkiisa (goorma, intee, yaa waxa bixiya, intee ayuu hubaal yahay). Kadibna xaqiiqo kasta calaamadee dib-u-sheegid kasta.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.1: Raadi dib-u-sheegid halkaas oo mid ka mid ah xaqiiqooyinkaaga taxan uu maqan yahay ama la rogay.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.a: Lacagta baska waxay kor u kacaysaa 200 won bisha dambe, laakiin ma khuseeyo waayeelka.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.a: Tani waxay ilaaliyaa qorshaha, xaddiga iyo ka reebitaanka, sidaa darteed waa daacad.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.b: Lacagta baska waxay kor u kacaysaa 200 won bisha dambe qof walba.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.c: Laga bilaabo bisha dambe waayeelku waxay sii bixinayaan 1,500 won; kuwa kale waxay bixiyaan 200 won oo dheeraad ah.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.c: Tani waa daacad oo qaybta ku saabsan waayeelka marka hore ayay dhigaysaa.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.o.d: Magaaladu waxay leedahay lacagtu waxay kor u kacaysaa 200 won laga bilaabo bisha dambe.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa daacad: waxay ilaaliyaa yaa sheegay iyo inay weli tahay qorshe.
n-k-k9-05.s.s1.explain: Maqaalku wuxuu leeyahay lacagtu waxaa la qorsheeyay inay kor u kacdo bisha dambe, dadka 65 jir iyo ka weynna waxay sii haystaan lacagtii hore. Nuskhadda la dhega-nuglaysay waxay leedahay kororku wuxuu khuseeyaa qof walba, sidaa darteed waxay tuurtaa ka reebitaanka ayeeyadaada muhiimka u ah.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.prompt: Weedhee furitaan ah ayaa ku habboon hadalka ayeeyadaada?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.0: Eeg dhammaadyada weedhaha: kuwee ayaa loogu talagalay miiska wararka, kuwee na qolka qoyska?
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii falku yahay eray maalinle ah ama eray joornaal.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.b: Tani weli waa ku dhawaaqid qaab war ah oo aad u adag hadalka qoyska.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.c: Dhammaadka caadiga ah ee caadiga ahi ma ixtiraamo ayeeyo, -니까 na wuxuu u dhawaaqaa mid sabar la'aan ah.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.r.d: '인상되오니 … 바랍니다' waa luqadda looxa ogeysiisyada, wuxuuna kororka u sheegaa sida go'an halkii uu u sheegi lahaa sida la soo sheegay.
n-k-k9-05.s.s2.explain: Hadalka qoyska ee waayeelka waa edeb laakiin jilicsan (-요), wuxuu isticmaalaa erayo maalinle ah (오르다 halkii 인상되다) -대요 na wuxuu soo sheegaa waxa qof kale yiri.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.prompt: Hadda ayeeyadaada u sheeg erayadaada Kuuriyaan: ugu badnaan laba weedhood, hadal edeb leh oo -요 ah, dhammaadyo war la'aan. Ilaali taariikhda, xaddiga, in ay qorshe yihiin oo keliya, iyo waxa iyada khuseeya.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.0: Weedha koowaad: goorma, intee, iyo inay tahay qorshe. Weedha labaad: maxay macnaheedu u tahay iyada.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.hint.1: Eray kasta oo joornaal ah ku beddel erayga aad miiska casho ku isticmaali lahayd.
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma nuskhaddaydu weli waxay leedahay kororku waa qorshe oo keliya?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma ayeeyadaydu waxay ogaan lahayd inay iyadu laftideeda bixiso isku mid?
n-k-k9-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma erayadaydu waa kuwo aan runtii guriga ku odhan lahaa?
